newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean 3-yr yields end lower on fewer new issues.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean 3-yr yields end lower on fewer new issues.

text.p: Yields on three-year corporates ended slightly lower on Tuesday after fluctuating narrowly due to scanty new issues, brokers said.
Three-month CD yields and the overnight call rates rose due to tightening liquidity in the short-term money market.
* 3-yr corporates end at 12.23 pct from 12.25 on Monday
Three-month CD yields and the overnight call rates rose due to tightening liquidity.
Brokers said the central bank's dollar sales in the foreign exchange market to support the local currency pressured the short-term money market.
They said the money demand in the short-term market would continue to rise for the time being.
